goal_ru: После урока ты сможешь рассказать, что происходило, когда случилось событие.
can_do_en: I can describe what was happening when something happened.

words.example_en: While I was coding, my cat jumped on the keyboard.
words.example_ru: Пока я программировал, кот прыгнул на клавиатуру.

words.example_en: I was sleeping when the alarm rang.
The lights went out during the final.
What were you doing when it happened?
words.example_ru: Что ты делал, когда это случилось?

grammar.title_ru: Past Continuous (was/were + -ing) и Past Simple вместе
grammar.explain_ru: Past Continuous — «фон», длинное действие в прошлом: I was playing, they were sleeping (was/were + -ing). Past Simple — короткое событие, которое «врезалось»: the lights went out. Вместе: I was playing (фон) when the lights went out (событие). While + фон: While I was coding, the cat jumped on the keyboard. Вопрос: What were you doing at 9 last night?
grammar.explain_en: Past Continuous (was/were + -ing) for the background, Past Simple for the short event: I was playing when the lights went out. While I was coding, my cat jumped on the keyboard.

examples.en: I was winning the match when the game crashed!
examples.ru: Я выигрывал матч, когда игра вылетела!

examples.en: While we were walking home, it started to snow.
examples.ru: Пока мы шли домой, пошёл снег.

examples.en: What were you doing at nine last night? — I was watching a stream.
examples.ru: Что ты делал вчера в девять? — Смотрел стрим.

mistakes.wrong: I played when the lights were going out.
mistakes.right: I was playing when the lights went out.

mistakes.wrong: When I was coding, the cat was jumping on the keyboard (о прыжке).

grammar.tutor_notes_ru: Рисовать на экране «длинную линию» (фон) и «молнию» (событие). Истории-катастрофы: игра вылетела, свет погас, кот на клавиатуре — смешно и запоминается.

phrases.en: I was just about to win!

topics_ru: что ты делал вчера в 9 вечера
questions_en: What were you doing at nine last night?
Has a game ever crashed when you were winning?
What were you doing when you heard some big news?
Tell me about a time something went wrong.
talk.tutor_notes_ru: Нейт рассказывает своё «падение сервера во время урока» — ученик отвечает своей историей.

tasks.ask_ru: Поставь глаголы в Past Continuous или Past Simple.
tasks.text: I ___ (play) the final round when my mum ___ (turn off) the Wi-Fi.

tasks.question: While we ___ to school, we saw an accident.

tasks.ask_ru: Комната в момент, когда погас свет. Скажи, кто что делал, когда это случилось.
tasks.ask_en: What were they doing when the lights went out?

image.prompt_en: A family living room at the moment of a power cut, dark with a lightning icon: a boy at a computer with headphones, a girl painting, dad cooking in the kitchen, a cat on the table eating, mum on the phone, playful flat illustration with dim light, no text
image.alt_ru: Момент отключения света: мальчик за компьютером в наушниках, девочка рисует, папа готовит, кот на столе ест, мама говорит по телефону.

tasks.say: What were they doing when the lights went out?
tasks.example: When the lights went out, the boy was playing a game. His sister was painting. Dad was cooking dinner. Mum was talking on the phone. And the cat was eating from the table!

tasks.ask_ru: Послушай без текста. Что случилось, пока Артём писал код?
tasks.ask_en: Listen. What happened while Artyom was coding?
tasks.audio: I was writing the code for my project. It was almost finished. While I was saving the file, my laptop suddenly turned off — the battery was dead. And I didn't have a copy.
tasks.question: Что случилось?

tasks.ask_ru: Расскажи свою историю «всё шло хорошо, когда вдруг…».
tasks.ask_en: Tell me a story when something suddenly went wrong.
tasks.say: Tell me about a moment when everything was going well — and then suddenly…
tasks.example: Last month I was playing in an online tournament. We were winning 2–0. Suddenly my internet stopped working. While I was trying to reconnect, my team lost the round. Just my luck!

homework.about_ru: Спроси двоих: What were you doing at 8 pm yesterday? Перескажи Нейту — и добавь, что делал ты.

tasks.ask_ru: Что делали ты и двое других вчера в 8 вечера.
tasks.ask_en: What were you and two other people doing at 8 pm yesterday?
tasks.say: Yesterday at 8 pm. You and two other people.
tasks.example: At eight o'clock yesterday I was doing my homework. My dad was watching the news and my sister was talking to her friend on the phone.

pass.about_ru: Пройден, если верно 75% заданий и в истории (t5) фон и событие в правильных временах.

review.note_ru: Present Continuous → Past Continuous; неправильные глаголы.
